task_0_novelty: not done: CRN is established in general and for hyperparameter search, but no work found quantifies the cross-recipe correlation of seed deviations in language-model pretraining, the implied gap-variance reduction, or its effect on the resolvable fraction of recipe pairs

task_1.design_status: data_seed equals the seed index and is identical across all 7 recipes, with the same corpus, tokenizer, context and batch; the loader is not in the release, so data-order identity is probable but not verified; recipes train on different token counts, so at most a shared order prefix is possible; initialisation is not shared (architectures differ)
task_1.note: three seeds per recipe; the interval is wide

task_2.note: three runs per arm, F(2, 2); an upper bound on data-order-only CRN

not_tested_by_tasks_1_2: cross-recipe correlation when recipes share the architecture and the initialisation is copied explicitly (the regime Task 3 would use); Task 2's point estimate puts most seed variance in initialisation, which only such a design could share
